The Company and T Second India Private limited had recently entered into a Teaming agreement to 
evaluate options to work on common areas of interest which would complement each other’s capabilities. 
T Second India Private Limited, is engaged in the business of the design, development, and manufacturing 
of hyperconverged platforms for edge environments. T Second India Private Limited is wholly owned 
subsidiary of T Second Inc, USA 
 
The purchase orders as above have been awarded to the Company in pursuance to the opportunities 
identified through the above Teaming agreement in the areas of:
